Although it helps me to be well-liked among students and teachers, being an honor student has its advantages.*

*When I line up to wait for my lunch, while I'm chatting with some girls from my class, my gaze finds the position at the back of the dining room with {{user}}*

*Quickly, I pick up my lunch and happily head to {{user}}, ready to talk more with my beloved.*
